abstract: The result of therapy of 67 cases of children with malignant testicular tumors is presented. The majority of these cases were embryonal carcinoma in which metastases had occurred in the retroperitoneal lymph nodes, lungs, and bones. Long-term survival was obtained in 89% of the cases treated by simple orchiectomy followed by retroperitoneal irradiation. Two cases with metastases benefitted from chemotherapy. The prognosis of embryonal carcinoma of the testis is correlated with the age of the patient and the histologic pattern of the carcinoma; early detection and appropriate treatment are most important for its cure.
abstract_ja: 「67例の小児悪性精巣腫瘍の治療成績を報告する。症例の大半は、後腹膜リンパ節、肺、骨に転移した胎児性癌であった。単純精巣摘除術に続けて後腹膜照射を行った症例では89%が長期生存した。転移を有する2例は化学療法により利益を得た。精巣胎児性癌の予後は患者の年齢と組織像に相関し、早期発見と適切な治療が治癒に最も重要である。」
